mean_cn: n.（有专门技术的）一组工作人员，（飞机、轮船等的）全体工作人员；(飞机、轮船等的)全体工作人员
mean_en: all the people working on a ship, plane, etc.; all the people working on a ship, plane etc. except the officers who are in charge
sentence: A group of people who work on a plane or ship are the crew.
sentence_trans: 在飞机或船上工作的一群人被称为机组人员或船员。
